captures.title: WIFI CONSOLE REFERENCE - extracted from source; NOT a board session
captures.displayed_text:
Where: USB monitor, 115200 baud, board running wifi firmware.
Commands below are entered in the monitor, not the Ubuntu shell.

commands:
  info                    version, uptime, link and network state
  params                  every tunable: value, unit, default
  get <key>               one value
  set <key> <value>       change one, bounds enforced here
  reset <key> | reset all restore the compiled-in default
  wifi                    list known networks (never the passwords)
  wifi add <ssid> <pass>  add or replace one
  wifi del <ssid>         forget one
  wifi first <ssid>       try this one first
  agent                   where the micro-ROS agent is being looked for
  agent <host|ip>         point the robot at one; agent auto = discover
  compass                 heading, field strength and calibration state
  compass clear           forget the calibration - the way back from a bad one

  there is no save command - every change is written to NVS at once
ok

SSID is one token (no spaces); password is the rest of the line.
Example: wifi add Workshop24G YOUR_WIFI_PASSWORD
Example: agent 192.0.2.10  (replace with your server LAN address)
Stop the robot before changing networks. Do not share a real password.
